title: The arrival of bossa nova
summary: Dizzy, Charlie Byrd and Stan Getz brought bossa nova, which he regrets did not become popular for dancing.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: What's your first memory of Bossa Nova coming in?

Dizzy coming back from South America talking about this beautiful music and then Donald Byrd, what's his name, Charlie Byrd went down there and he did some things down there. Then, naturally, Stan Getz made the two recordings and they were a big hit: "The Girl from Ipanema", especially, and "Desafinado". It's marvelous really music. I'm sorry it didn't become popular in this country. I think if the American public could have learned to dance to it, that would have been wonderful, because it was just made for jazz musicians.
